body: Move surface ('aux_pane', 'global', 'file') and extensions (['.agbplan']) from _meta.ui into _meta['com.google.antigravity/ui'] on agb_flight_deck, agb_mission_control, and agb_plan_viewer in mcp/server.mjs. Support opaque antigravity-file:// URIs in agb_plan_viewer (mcp/server.mjs) and buildPlanViewerHtml (mcp/ui-views.mjs) via deferredRead: true + __bridge.readResource / __bridge.writeResource. Track clientSupportsUiExtension on initialize and emit sidecarHint ('agb sidecar <repo>') for non-UI clients in agb_flight_deck, agb_mission_control, and agb_run. Update mcp_config.json to command 'node', args ['${PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/mcp-server.mjs'], timeoutSeconds -1, and tools metadata (agb_run background='always', agb_status/agb_doctor eager=true). Expand test/mcp-apps.test.mjs.
title: MCP Apps Host Surfaces, antigravity-file://, Sidecar Hint & mcp_config.json
